222-527-8201-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-8201-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

225-2645-3430-6256.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7159.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1274-2685-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2685-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7724.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

439-803-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Arashin Sovereign's power, which will cause you to mill Arashin Sovereign.
As Arashin Sovereign is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Arashin Sovereign from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-6529-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

851-967-2921-3809-7087.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5402-6595.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

4771-5220-6794-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1308-2957-4508-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2316-3000-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-3000-4050.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating three 1/1 Goblin and three 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

3480-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

1770-2608-5168--108.easyPrerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.
1770-2608-5168--108.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Holding priority, activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
1770-2608-5168--108.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanent(s) using Derevi's trigger. The card you use to clone / copy Derevi must not bypass the legend rule. The copy must be legendary and have Derevi's name for the legend rule to take effect appropriately.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2897-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2897-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Gigantoplasm has a power of at least 2.
2897-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Gigantoplasm and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Gigantoplasm from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Gigantoplasm to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Gigantoplasm enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Gigantoplasm by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2857-5231.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2857-5231.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2857-5231.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Thermopod
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1115-1379-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1115-1379-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-1379-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

719-997-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-997-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-997-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Snail, causing you to scry 1.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

413-2730-4871-5006.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
413-2730-4871-5006.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

803-2380-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2380-2534.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

2210-2232-3094-3475-4768.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You have at least one non-Saga enchantment card in hand.
2210-2232-3094-3475-4768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and targeting it, copying The World Spell's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The World Spell's trigger, putting Mirrormade and any non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Choose to have Mirrormade enter the battlefield as a copy of The World Spell, with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Mirrormade triggers once, and Cloudstone Curio and Altar of the Brood each trigger twice.
Resolve both Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mirrormade and any other non-Saga enchantment from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mirrormade trigger, putting it and the non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

380-3362-4050.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
380-3362-4050.notes: You can add infinite {B} and {R} to use for Bladewing's ability infinitely.

1870-2056-4873.notablePrerequisites:
Eternity Vessel has at least twenty charge counters on it.
Saheeli has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1870-2056-4873.description:
Activate Saheeli by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing Eternity Vessel to become a copy of Darksteel Reactor until end of turn.
Eternity Vessel's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1298-2034-3940.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Ovika, Birgi and Haze of Rage's storm ability trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Ovika trigger, creating two 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying Haze of Rage for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first copy of Haze of Rage, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining copy.
Resolve the original Haze of Rage, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Goblins, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

245-1722-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
245-1722-4050.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Marneus.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Resolve the Marneus trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2781-4284.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Clone.
2781-4284.description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Clone. Choose to have Clone enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

864-1311-3657.description:
Cast Mobilize.
Tap your creatures for {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Spend {1}{G} to return Eternal Witness.
Cast Eternal Witness for {1}{G}{G}, returning Mobilize.
Repeat.

742-2836.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
742-2836.description:
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming Laboratory Maniac and thus exiling your library due to you not having a card named Laboratory Maniac in your library.
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.
